definition.text: (1.) A son of Gomer, and grandson of Japheth (Gen. 10:3). (2.) A nation which traded in horses and mules at the fairs of Tyre (Ezek. 27:14; 38:6); probably an Armenian or a Scythian race; descendants of (1).

lemmas.gloss: Togarmah, a son of Gomer and his posterity
Gomer, the name of a son of Japheth and of his descendan
Riphath, a grandson of Japheth and his descendants
Ashkenaz, a Japhethite, also his descendants
